scripts.build: echo '🔧 Starting build process...' && cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && echo '📦 Installing Python dependencies...' && python3 --version && which python3 && which pip3 && apt-get update && apt-get install -y python3-pip python3-dev build-essential && pip3 install --upgrade pip && pip3 install flask flask-sqlalchemy sqlalchemy psycopg2-binary flask-cors flask-jwt-extended python-dotenv gunicorn email-validator pillow reportlab python-docx && echo '✅ Python dependencies installed'
scripts.postinstall: echo '🔧 Postinstall: Installing Python dependencies...' && python3 --version && pip3 install flask flask-sqlalchemy sqlalchemy psycopg2-binary flask-cors flask-jwt-extended python-dotenv gunicorn email-validator pillow reportlab python-docx
